title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 50 (Performance in manner or at time prescribed or sanctioned by promisee)

content.overview: Section 50 provides that the performance of any promise may be made in any manner, or at any time which the promisee prescribes or sanctions.
content.glance: Promisee may prescribe or sanction the manner or time of performance.
content.study: Performance of any promise may be made in any manner or at any time which the promisee prescribes or sanctions. This allows the promisee to accept a different mode or time. Current-law framing: identify any prescription or sanction by the promisee as to manner or time; treat performance accordingly as valid under s. 50.

sections.heading: Manner or time prescribed or sanctioned
sections.body: Performance may be made in any manner or at any time which the promisee prescribes or sanctions.

provisions.title: Performance in manner or at time prescribed or sanctioned by promisee

examples.title: Promisee sanctions different time
examples.body: A is to pay B on 1 March. B asks A to pay on 15 March instead and accepts. Performance on 15 March is valid under s. 50.

hypotheticals.question: Can the promisee validly accept a different mode of performance?
hypotheticals.analysis: Yes. Section 50 allows performance in any manner or at any time which the promisee prescribes or sanctions.

misconceptions.trap: Performance must always follow the original contractual manner and time strictly.
misconceptions.correction: Section 50 allows the promisee to prescribe or sanction a different manner or time.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 50 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify any prescription or sanction by the promisee. II. Apply validity of that manner or time. III. Conclude.

examTips: State that the promisee’s prescription or sanction validates manner or time.
